changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Retained files.pythonhosted.org for the pinned NCCL wheel and removed docker.io because the base image is transferred separately.
changes.summary: Restricted the dual-Spark Qwen build to its exact wheel download host.

changes.details: The immutable adapter now returns zero for empty or non-finite selected-KV attention, aborts sixteen-token token-id-0 loops, excludes poisoned completions from radix insertion, resets prefix cache before the next prefill, and enables SGLang NaN-logit sanitation.
changes.summary: Advanced to MiaAI-Lab 0f950012 and hardened long-context QSA failure handling.

changes.details: Binds SGLANG_HOST_IP to each rank's ConnectX address, replaces the unsafe SM121 sparse-decode routes with SGLang's packed Triton fallback, retains CUDA-graph-safe NVFP4 KV, and adds the FP8 GQA upcast variant.
changes.summary: Updated to MiaAI-Lab's SM121-safe dual-Spark serving revision.

changes.details: Raises the advertised context contract from 900,000 to 1,048,576 tokens while retaining 1,024-token chunks, 28 request slots, MTP3, and Candidate status pending Vonk's own physical long-context acceptance.
changes.summary: Adopted the upstream 1M YaRN launch profile.

changes.details: Pins the first immutable upstream 900K revision and packages its QSA NVFP4-KV patches, YaRN extension, 28 request slots, automatic PLE placement, 1024-token prefill chunks, and MTP3 settings.
changes.summary: Aligned the default with MiaAI-Lab's announced and tested 900K two-Spark profile.

changes.details: The recipe pins all 135,253,622,894 model bytes and rebuilds the public MiaAI-Lab QSA fallback on an immutable ARM64 SGLang image with exact NCCL 2.30.7, native TP2 rendezvous, PLE offload, bounded 262K context, and MTP3.
changes.summary: Added an executable two-Spark Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 SGLang Candidate.
